name: tui
label: TUI
description: Terminal-UI aesthetic — tig/lazygit/k9s in the browser. Monospace everywhere, ANSI 16-color palette, ASCII box-drawing for tree views, simulated cursor block at heading ends, no anti-aliasing on glyphs. Doubles down on the meta-joke that you're viewing git source in the browser through something that looks like the CLI you'd reach for otherwise.
